svg.text: DI03005041 • Unit 1 • Syllabus1.3.1 • Sulphur-burning,3+1 catalyst-bed arrangement
Purple:process path • Teal dashed:recycle • Brown:feed • Numbered equipment and stream key below
SO3 removal occurs BETWEEN conversion groups;oleum+acid absorption only after a converter is not DCDA.
STREAM KEY—follow arrows and numbered equipment
L4 E13 → E15: Product acid bleed
R1 E14 → E07: Cooled strong acid
R2 E14 → E11: Cooled strong acid
F2 To E03: Filtered molten sulphur
F4 To E13: Controlled water / acid make-up
P1 From E12: Tail gas to controlled stack
Study PFD only • no operating recipe • crossing lines without a junction mark are not stream mixing points
